description: 智能阅读与概念图谱 Web 系统 - 本地化知识管理，通过 LLM 将 EPUB/PDF 转化为结构化概念图谱

userStories.title: Setup Rust backend project structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to set up the Rust backend project with Axum framework and required dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new Rust project with Cargo.toml
Add dependencies: axum, tokio, serde, sqlx, pdf-extract, epub, reqwest, uuid, chrono
Create basic Axum server with CORS enabled
Add health endpoint GET /api/health returning {"status": "ok"}
Server starts on localhost:8080
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create SQLite database schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the database schema for books, chunks, nodes, edges, and settings tables.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQLite database file at ./data/reader.db
Create books table: id (UUID), title, author, file_path, format (pdf/epub), total_pages, created_at
Create chunks table: id (UUID), book_id (FK), page_start, page_end, content, created_at
Create nodes table: id (UUID), book_id (FK nullable for global), name, description, examples (JSON), source_chunk_ids (JSON), language, category, created_at
Create edges table: id (UUID), source_node_id (FK), target_node_id (FK), relation_type, source_chunk_ids (JSON), created_at
Create settings table: key (PK), value, updated_at
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement settings API for language preference
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement the settings API to store and retrieve user language preference.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/settings/language returns {"language": "zh"} or {"language": "en"}
PUT /api/settings/language accepts {"language": "zh"} or {"language": "en"}
Default language is zh (Chinese)
Settings stored in SQLite settings table
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement books API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement CRUD API endpoints for books management.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/books/upload accepts multipart/form-data with file field
POST /api/books/upload returns book_id and saves file to ./data/books/
GET /api/books returns list of books with id, title, author, format, total_pages
GET /api/books/:id returns full book details including file_path
DELETE /api/books/:id deletes book and associated chunks, nodes, edges
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement chunks API endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement the chunks API to retrieve chunk data for a book.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/books/:id/chunks returns array of chunks
Each chunk has: id (UUID), book_id, page_start, page_end, content (first 200 chars for list)
GET /api/chunks/:id returns full chunk content
Chunks are created during document parsing
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement graph API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement graph API to retrieve nodes and edges for visualization.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/books/:id/graph returns {nodes: [...], edges: [...]} for single book
GET /api/graph/global returns {nodes: [...], edges: [...]} for all books merged
GET /api/nodes/:id returns node details with full description and examples
Nodes have: id, name, description, examples (array), source_chunk_ids (array)
Edges have: id, source_node_id, target_node_id, relation_type
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement PDF parsing and chunking
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement PDF parsing to extract text and create chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse PDF file using pdf-extract crate
Extract text content per page maintaining page numbers
Create chunks: each chunk is one page or portion (~1000 chars with overlap)
Each chunk gets a UUID stored in chunks table
Store page_start and page_end for each chunk
Ignore images, extract only text
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement EPUB parsing and chunking
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement EPUB parsing to extract text and create chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse EPUB file using epub crate
Extract text content maintaining chapter/section structure
Create chunks based on chapters or ~1000 char segments with overlap
Each chunk gets a UUID stored in chunks table
Store page_start (chapter index) and page_end
Ignore images, extract only text
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement LLM client for concept extraction
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement LLM client to call LM Studio API for concept extraction.
acceptanceCriteria: Create LLM client connecting to http://localhost:1234/v1
Support chat completions endpoint with OpenAI-compatible interface
Build system prompt enforcing: output language (zh/en), source_chunk_id in response
Parse JSON response extracting: concepts, relations, explanations, examples
Handle connection errors gracefully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement concept extraction pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement the concept extraction pipeline that processes chunks through LLM.
acceptanceCriteria: Add POST /api/books/:id/extract endpoint to trigger extraction
Process chunks concurrently (max 3 parallel requests)
For each chunk, call LLM with chunk content and UUID
Parse LLM response, create nodes and edges in database
Each node/edge must have source_chunk_id referencing origin chunk
Return extraction status: {status: "processing" | "completed", nodes_count, edges_count}
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement entity deduplication
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement entity deduplication to merge similar concepts across chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Before creating new node, check existing nodes for similar name
Use simple string similarity (case-insensitive substring match)
If similar node exists (name A contains name B or vice versa), merge: keep existing node, add source_chunk_id
Merge edges pointing to duplicate nodes
Update existing node's source_chunk_ids array with new sources
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Setup React frontend project

acceptanceCriteria: Create Vite + React + TypeScript project
